tools.name: Compress
tools.summary: Pick photos, check the before/after preview, compress. Offline, with no internet permission.
features: Real quality: the encoder retries lower until the file actually gets smaller.
Downscale: cap the longest edge at 1280, 1920, 2560, 3200 or 4096 px, or keep the original.
Batch: up to 40 photos, per-file savings, then share them all in one go.
Orientation: EXIF rotation is applied to the pixels, so portrait shots stay upright.
Metadata: location and device tags are dropped during re-encode.
Non-destructive: copies go to Pictures/Compress, originals are untouched.
Verify: tapping a saved result reopens the slider so you can confirm the file matches the preview.

tools.name: Icons
tools.summary: All four icon brands offline: 4,373 icons, a live preview with weight, size and surface, copy to clipboard.
features: Two brands, 606 Lineicons and 1,258 Coolicons, bundled with the pages and the fonts.
Copy exports SVG, or a PNG, WEBP or JPG at 32-1024px drawn on the chosen background; the site also puts a PNG on the clipboard.
No content sits under the status bar or a camera cutout: the browser is inset.
Export the whole set, or whatever the filter shows, as one zip.
Black and white preview tiles, labelled plainly, for judging a glyph's contrast.
A preview tab whose weight, size and background repaint the glyph as you press.
The category you last picked is remembered per brand, and All icons forgets it.
Both brands filter by category, each with its vendor's own taxonomy, beside the name filter.
The whole set opens into a scrolling sheet instead of filling the page.
Copy hands over the untouched SVG: 24x24 viewBox, currentColor, no baked weight.
No INTERNET permission: the browser and the catalogs ship inside the APK.
The format, export size and background you pick are remembered per brand, like the category.
Export size opens a list of six sizes, from 32 to 1024px.
Format is a list too: SVG, PNG, WEBP or JPG, one at a time.
Double-tap a glyph to collect it for export, or Add all a whole category at once.
